title: Fix the SAL to SQL stage mapping in the lifecycle workflow
description:
The lifecycle workflow stamps `sal_date__latest_` before Sales has accepted the lead, so a slice of MQLs is being counted as SAL a day early. Suspected cause of the SAL to SQL conversion dip revops-watchdog has flagged three days running.

- [ ] Re-read the enrollment trigger
- [ ] Compare stamped dates against the accept event
- [ ] Backfill or restate if the mapping is wrong
